subject.title: Regenerar feeds de Merchant Center (multi-país): metadata completa + correcciones de mapeo

question: Should the team proceed with one coordinated Merchant Center feed redesign under MiguelHamelyn, including MX-first validation with Jesús and any missing country config, or split the mapper/code work from live upload operations?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the requested rollout order, Brazil coverage, and live Merchant Center upload sequence require human operational ownership rather than an autonomous cleanup close.

options.title: Coordinate one owned feed redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open under the assigned owner, implement the mapper and country orchestration together, and run MX proof with Jesús before other countries.

options.title: Split code and operations
options.body: Open a narrower code issue/PR for mapper and country support while tracking live uploads separately with the operations owner.

options.title: Defer Brazil or unconfirmed countries
options.body: Limit the first implementation to countries with confirmed config and document the remaining country enablement as follow-up.

recommendation.title: Coordinate one owned feed redesign
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the assigned owner, implement the mapper and country orchestration together, and run MX proof with Jesús before other countries.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is assigned to this issue and authored the recent Merchant feed refactor, US upload, and MX routing cleanup.
